title: Multilateral trade disputes  until 2016
descriptions: This dataset is in Excel, and it harmonizes the GATT with the WTO to facilitate comparison. It is the dataset that is split into bilateral trade disputes so that it can be used for the further economic analysis. An example is trade disputes and trade flow.

data_sources:
The dataset is compiled from the publicly accessible website of the WTO for the disputes from 1995: https://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/dispu_e/dispu_status_e.htm
For the disputes from 1947 until 1994, the GATT disputes from 
WorldTradeLaw.net, on https://www.worldtradelaw.net
